item.title: Kansas marijuana laws remain unchanged, despite Trump promoting looser regulations
item.description: President Donald Trump took the first step Thursday to reclassify marijuana, but the move won’t affect Kansans unless the state changes its laws, a law enforcement professional said. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kansas Supreme Court chief justice to retire by early February
item.description: Kansas Supreme Court Chief Justice Marla Luckert will step down from her position at the start of the new year and retire within weeks, she announced Friday. Continue reading ...

item.title: Loving Paws therapy dogs provide a fuzzy shoulder to lean on
item.description: Even if dogs can’t solve the world’s biggest problems, they can be present at just the right moment for folks who need a fuzzy shoulder to lean on, Loving Paws Animal Therapy's volunteer coordinator believes. Continue reading ...

item.title: City of Lawrence snowplow, newly dubbed ‘The Blizzard of Oz,’ ready to take to the streets
item.description: "Taylor Drift" was so last season. Now, there's a new name in town among the city's snowplow fleet, and the machine has been adorned with a custom magnet. Continue reading ...

item.title: New brewery, speakeasy to claim its territory in former Black Stag location
item.description: A stag and an elk walk into a bar and, no joke, they will aim to make Lawrence’s newest rootin’ tootin’ brewery with live country music and a speakeasy. Continue reading ...

item.title: Santa Claus’ associates in Lawrence usher in holiday cheer
item.description: Since Santa Claus must conserve energy for his Christmas Eve omnipresence, he wisely delegates some duties to remote workers. Here are a few of the Lawrence locals who signed on to give Santa a helping hand this year. Continue reading ...

item.title: Photos: Lawrence community menorot lighting
item.description: Members of the Lawrence Jewish Community Congregation gathered Saturday evening to celebrate Hanukkah with menorot lighting, a potluck, and fellowship. Continue reading ...

item.title: Details, renderings unveiled for KU entrepreneurship hub planned for former bookstore site
item.description: The former Jayhawk Bookstore/McLain's Bakery building has been demolished to make way for KU's entrepreneurship hub. The project team has shared more details about what the hub will entail and renderings of the planned building. Continue reading ...

item.title: Kaw Valley Almanac for Dec. 22-28, 2025
